dialog.destination_change_message:
Apply this configuration to the {count} profiles of project “{name}”?

Game save: {path}

Choose whether to keep the backup copies at the current location:

Copy: copy the backups to the new location and keep the existing copies.
Move: move the backups to the new location and remove the existing copies.
Cancel: leave the current configuration unchanged.
The current game save will not be changed.
